name: AIOStreams
subtitle: Jellyfin on iPhone and iPad
description: A native AIOStreams app for iPhone and iPad, made for watching and playing through AetherEngine. Every update says what changed, and earlier versions stay installable from the version history. Your sideloading tool signs the app when you install it.

apps.name: AIOStreams
apps.subtitle: AIOStreams and Jellyfin, played properly
apps.localizedDescription:
A native iPhone and iPad app for your AIOStreams and Jellyfin library. It plays through AetherEngine, so Dolby Vision, HDR10, HDR10+, Atmos and image subtitles work where Safari and AVPlayer give up.

• Smart downloads keep the next episodes of a show on your device and remove them once watched
• Downloads carry on in the background, play offline and sync what you watched later
• A skip intro countdown, Picture in Picture that hands off to the mini player, and trailers
• Subtitles in your own style, spoiler blur, brightness and volume swipes, light haptics
• Optional anime upscaling on iOS 26

Unofficial and unsigned: your sideloading tool signs it when you install.

versions.localizedDescription:
What's new
• Move links and identity to the hyperionyxdev account
• Remove the Apple TV app; the repository ships the iPhone and iPad app only
• Leave the source bookkeeping commit out of release notes
• Describe the app as it is now, in its own words

Full notes: https://github.com/hyperionyxdev/aiostreams-ios/releases/tag/v0.2.91

What's new
• AetherEngine 7.66.1: AAC surround, image subtitle and HEVC remux fixes
• FlareStore source: v0.2.89

Full notes: https://github.com/9pbpsvr6f9-alt/aiostreams-ios/releases/tag/v0.2.90

What's new
• Serve the FlareStore source from one fixed address

Full notes: https://github.com/9pbpsvr6f9-alt/aiostreams-ios/releases/tag/v0.2.89

What's new
• Skip the iPhone build for changes to tv-m only
• Build on the xcode-27 runner by default
• Keep the player's full screen request when a trailer held the video

Full notes: https://github.com/9pbpsvr6f9-alt/aiostreams-ios/releases/tag/v0.2.87

What's new
• Launch logo, anime upscaling, and PiP with the mini player (#9)

Full notes: https://github.com/9pbpsvr6f9-alt/aiostreams-ios/releases/tag/v0.2.74

What's new
• Name smart shows in Settings, drop the iOS download tooltip, dress up the source
• Put Download beside Favourite on iOS and list smart shows in Settings
• Add downloads on iOS, with smart downloads that keep a show's next episodes
• Show the volume toast for the volume buttons in the player
• Show iOS's volume indicator everywhere but the full-window player

Full notes: https://github.com/9pbpsvr6f9-alt/aiostreams-ios/releases/tag/v0.2.64
